r.name: 39 Ulàssai - Sentieri dei Nuraghi e di "Su Marmuri"
T741 - Ruinas - Punta La Marmora
r.description: An interesting route to Punta La Marmora. After an initial stretch on a dirt road, the trail winds through a small valley filled with water and trees. It passes a beautiful spring, then reaches the very scenic southern ridge that leads to the summit.

r.name: T702 - Bruncu Spina - Punta La Marmora
r.description: The route follows a hillside path to the Arcu Gennargentu saddle, with a very steep and slippery final section, then a scenic ridge to the summit. If possible, we recommend ascending via route 741 from the Nuragic site of Ruinas which is more rewarding.
